title: Hot Take: Luka Doncic's 53-point explosion pushes scoring average past 40 as La…
author: Rico
summary: ESPN's "Luka Doncic's 53-point explosion pushes scoring average past 40 as Lakers roll" is the headline, and I need to point out that this is two separate stories accidentally jammed into one chyron. Luka hung a season-high 53 points on the Trail Blazers in a 124-118 win, which is legitimately impressive and pushes his scoring average to 40.1 PPG. But the Lakers? They're doing their own thing entirely. This is the kind of multi-tasking headline construction that makes you wonder if the editor was watching two games at once or just hedging their bets on which box score would trend harder. Either way, Rico has thoughts, and the first one is: can we let Luka's night breathe for a second before we pivot to whatever LeBron did?

content.value:
## The Headline

ESPN — Ben Golliver: **"Luka Doncic's 53-point explosion pushes scoring average past 40 as Lakers roll"**

That's the kind of line that reads one way in October and a completely different way come April. Here's the read right now, before anyone's kept score. And yes, I noticed the Lakers somehow rolled their way into a headline about Luka dropping 53 points on Portland—classic ESPN geography right there.
